blocks.text: Deus in adiutórium meum inténde. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen. Allelúia.
blocks.translation: O God, come to my assistance. O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now and ever shall be for ever and ever. Amen. Alleluia.

blocks.chantTranslation: Behold a great priest, who in his days//pleased God and was found righteous.
_Ps. 109_//The Lord said to my Lord:
Sit at my right hand,

blocks.text:
1. Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
  2. Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
  3. Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
  4. Jurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
  5. Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
  6. Judicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
  7. De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
  8. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  9. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
  2. The Lord will send forth from Sion the sceptre of your power: rule in the midst of your enemies.
  3. With you is princely rule on the day of your strength, amid the splendours of the saints: from the womb, before the morning star, I begot you.
  4. The Lord has sworn, and he will not repent: You are a priest for ever according to the order of Melchizedek.


  5. The Lord at your right hand has crushed kings in the day of his wrath.
  6. He will judge among the nations; he will fill ruins: he will shatter heads in many lands.
  7. He will drink from the torrent on the way: therefore he will lift up his head.
  8. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Behold a great priest, who in his days//pleased God and was found righteous.
No one was found like him,//who kept the law of the Most High.
_Ps. 110_  I will give thanks to you,//O Lord, with my whole heart: in the council of the just and in the assembly.

blocks.text:
1. Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
  2. Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  3. Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, † miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.

  4. Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
  5. Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
  6. Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: † confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
  7. Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
  8. Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
  9. Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  10. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  11. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.
  2. His work is praise and majesty: * and his justice endures for ever and ever.
  3. He has made a remembrance of his wondrous works, † merciful and compassionate is the Lord: * he has given food to those who fear him.

  4. He will be mindful of his covenant for ever: * he will declare to his people the power of his works:
  5. That he may give them the inheritance of the nations: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.
  6. All his commandments are faithful: † confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.
  7. He has sent redemption to his people: * he has commanded his covenant for ever.
  8. Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
  9. A good understanding have all those who do it: * his praise endures for ever.
  10. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: No one was found like him,//who kept the law of the Most High.
Therefore the Lord made him grow//by an oath among his people.
_Ps. 111_  Blessed is the man who fears the Lord: who greatly delights//in his commandments.

blocks.text:
1. Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
  2. Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  3. Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
  4. Jucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, † dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
  5. In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
  6. Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, † confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
  7. Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: † iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
  8. Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, † déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
  9. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  10. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. His offspring shall be mighty upon the earth: * the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
  2. Glory and riches shall be in his house: * and his righteousness endures for ever and ever.
  3. A light has risen in the darkness for the upright: * he is merciful, compassionate, and just.
  4. Happy is the man who shows mercy and lends; † he shall order his affairs with judgment: * for he shall never be moved.
  5. The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear evil tidings.
  6. His heart is ready to trust in the Lord; † his heart is steadfast: * he shall not be moved until he looks down upon his enemies.
  7. He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; † his righteousness endures for ever and ever; * his horn shall be exalted in glory.
  8. The sinner shall see it and be angry; † he shall gnash his teeth and waste away: * the desire of sinners shall perish.
  9. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Therefore the Lord made him grow//by an oath among his people.
Priests of God, bless the Lord;//servants of the Lord,//sing a hymn to God, alleluia.
_Ps. 112_  Praise the Lord, O children://praise the name of the Lord.

blocks.text:
1. Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
  2. A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
  3. Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.
  4. Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
  5. Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
  6. Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
  7. Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
  8. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  9. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Let the name of the Lord be blessed, * from this time forth and for evermore.
  2. From the rising of the sun to its setting, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.
  3. The Lord is high above all nations, * and his glory above the heavens.
  4. Who is like the Lord our God, who dwells on high * and looks down upon the lowly in heaven and on earth?
  5. He raises up the needy from the earth, * and lifts the poor from the dungheap,
  6. To place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.
  7. He makes the barren woman dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.
  8. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Priests of God, bless the Lord;//servants of the Lord,//sing a hymn to God, alleluia.
Good and faithful servant,//enter into the joy of your Lord.
_Ps. 116_  Praise the Lord, all nations://praise him, all peoples.

blocks.text:
1. Quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius: * et véritas Dómini manet in ætérnum.
  2. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  3. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. For his mercy has been confirmed upon us, * and the truth of the Lord remains for ever.
  2. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Good and faithful servant,//enter into the joy of your Lord.

blocks.text:
Iste Conféssor Dómini sacrátus,
Festa plebs cuius célebrat per orbem,
Hódie lætus méruit secréta
Scándere cæli.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbrius, castus fuit, et quiétus,
Vita dum præsens vegetávit eius
Córporis artus.

Ad sacrum cuius túmulum frequénter,
Membra languéntum modo sanitáti,
Quolíbet morbo fúerint graváta,
Restituúntur.

Sit salus illi, decus, atque virtus,
Qui supra cæli résidens cacúmen,
Tótius mundi máchinam gubérnat
Trinus et unus. Amen.
blocks.translation:
This Confessor of the Lord, made holy,
whose feast the faithful people celebrate throughout the world,
today has joyfully merited to ascend
to the hidden places of heaven.

Who, devout, prudent, humble, and pure,
sober, chaste, and peaceful,
led his life while the strength of his body endured
in this present world.

At whose sacred tomb frequently
the weakened limbs of the sick,
oppressed by whatever illness,
are restored to health.

May salvation, honour, and power be his,
who, seated above the summit of heaven,
governs the machinery of the whole world,
Three and One. Amen.

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord loved him//and adorned him.
\R. He clothed him with a robe of glory.
Priest and Pontiff, and worker of//mighty deeds, good shepherd of the//people: pray to the Lord for us.

blocks.text:
1. Magníficat *  All sit ánima mea Dóminum.
  2. Et exsultávit spíritus meus * in Deo salutári meo.
  3. Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
  4. Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
  5. Et misericórdia eius a progénie in progénies * timéntibus eum.
  6. Fecit poténtiam in bráchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
  7. Depósuit poténtes de sede, * et exaltávit húmiles.
  8. Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
  9. Suscépit Israël púerum suum, * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.


  10. Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros, * Abraham et sémini eius in sǽcula.
  11. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  12. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. My soul * magnifies the Lord.
  2. And my spirit has rejoiced * in God my Saviour.
  3. For he has regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
  4. For he that is mighty has done great things to me; * and holy is his name.
  5. And his mercy is from generation unto generations * to those who fear him.
  6. He has shown strength with his arm; * he has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
  7. He has put down the mighty from their seat, * and has exalted the humble.
  8. He has filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he has sent away empty.
  9. He has helped his servant Israel, * being mindful of his mercy.
  10. As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.
  11. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Priest and Pontiff, and worker of//mighty deeds, good shepherd of the//people: pray to the Lord for us.

\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit. \V. Let us pray.

of blessed Birinus,//your Confessor and Bishop,
may increase in us both//devotion and salvation.
Through Our Lord Jesus Christ...

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God,//rest in peace.
